Source: Faith and Fire, @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.rules-reference-st.JournalEntry.yEPxZHRgMGIQ2JJQ]{Derangements}

An overcompensating character attempts to make up for a flaw in her character (real or perceived) by stressing another aspect of her personality, limiting her actions and skewing her perceptions of the world. She may take a "holier than thou" attitude toward others, lecturing them about their shortcomings and constantly attempting to take the moral high ground.

Trigger/Effect: If the character's own flaws are revealed, the embarrassment is acute and her reaction unpredictable - check for frenzy.
